text.tspan: Backend Pipeline: Dynamic Standard Selection Drives Everything
User picks industry + standards on screen. The system evaluates only those standards and returns exactly matching reports.

g.text: STEP 1 — SELECTION SCREEN (what the user sees)
STEP 3 — EVALUATE (one engine per picked standard, in parallel)

text.tspan: Underneath the standard-specific reports: every control is tagged to one of 5 governance pillars —
Trust, Security, Governance, Compliance, Data Protection — so results stay comparable across industries and standards. See Section 6.
